TRANSPORTATION AND PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  TEMPLE CITY, CALIFORNIA

  REGULAR MEETING
  JULY 22, 2026 - 7:00 P.M.
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS– 5938 KAUFFMAN AVE

  AGENDA

PROCEDURE TO ADDRESS TRANSPORTATION AND PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION: If
you wish to address the Transportation and Public Safety Commission, please complete a
speaker request form, indicating the agenda item number and submit it to the Clerk. There will
be a 3-minute time limit on each speaker, unless waived by the Commission. You have the
opportunity to address the Commission at the following times:

  •  AGENDA ITEM: at the time the Commission considers the agenda item.

  •  NON-AGENDA ITEM: at the time for PUBLIC COMMENTS. Please note that while
  the Commission values your comments, pursuant to the Brown Act, the Commission
  cannot take action on any item not listed on the agenda.

The listing of any items on the agenda includes the authority of the Commission to take action
on such item and to approve, disapprove, or give direction on any item.

  1.  CALL TO ORDER – Chairman Stoll

  2.  ROLL CALL – Commissioner Lo, Nimri, Xu, Catalan, Stoll

  3.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  4.  CEREMONIAL MATTERS – None

  5.  PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA

  The Transportation and Public Safety Commission will now hear public
  comments regarding items not listed on the agenda. The procedure to address
  the Commission is highlighted on the first page of this agenda.

  6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  All Consent Calendar items may be approved in a single motion as
  recommended unless removed for further discussion. If members of the
  Commission or persons in the audience wish to discuss any matters listed on
  the Consent Calendar, please address them at this time.

  Recommendation:  Approve Item A per recommendation.

  A.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES – REGULAR MEETING OF JUNE 24, 2026.

  Recommendation:  Approve.

7.  PARKING CITATION HEARINGS

  Please note that the hearing is an informal proceeding and the rules of evidence
  required in a court trial do not apply.

  Hearing Procedures:

  1.  When your case is called, approach the podium and state your name
  for the record.
  2.  State whether or not you are the registered owner of the vehicle cited.
  If you are not the owner, please state your relationship to the owner.
  3.  Present your case to the Commission. If you are submitting any
  documents or photographs relevant to your case, they will be retained
  by the City as part of the official file.
  4.  The Commission will render a decision to uphold or dismiss your
  citation. A written notification of the Commission’s decision will be
  mailed to you.
  5.  If your citation is upheld, you may appeal the decision of the
  Commission to the Los Angeles Superior Court – Stanley Mosk
  Courthouse. You must file your appeal within 30 days from the date
  the written notification is mailed to you.

  A. HEARINGS IN PERSON

  1.  Jesus Romero  Citation No.TC050008131
  2.  Joseph Buddenberg  Citation No.TC050007894

  B. WRITTEN DECLARATION – None

8.  UNFINISHED BUSINESS – None

9.  NEW BUSINESS

  A. REVIEW THE TRAFFIC ENGINEERING RECOMMENDATIONS FOR

  OAK AVENUE BETWEEN ROWLAND AVENUE AND BALDWIN AVENUE,
  AND APPROVE OR DENY THE PROPOSED RECOMMENDATIONS.

  PRESENTER:  Brian Cervantes, Transtech Engineers

  The Transportation and Public Safety Commission is requested to review
  Resolution No, 26-0005 and approve or deny the engineering
  recommendations.

  INSTALL TWO FEET OF RED CURB ON BOTH SIDES OF THE
  DRIVEWAY AT 10112 DAINES, AND APPROVE THE FUTURE
  INSTALLATION OF TWO FEET OF RED CURB AT OTHER RESIDENTIAL

11.  ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA - None

minutes_text:
TRANSPORTATION AND PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  TEMPLE CITY, CALIFORNIA

  REGULAR MEETING MINUTES
  JUNE 24, 2026

1.  CALL TO ORDER

  Chairperson Nimri called the Transportation and Public Safety Commission
  Meeting to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  ROLL CALL

  PRESENT:  Commissioner – Lo, Nimri, Xu, Stoll
  ABSENT:  Commissioner – Catalan
  EXCUSED:  Commissioner – None

  ALSO PRESENT:  City Manager Cook, Secretary Monroy and Deputy Bui.

3.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Chairperson Nimri led those present in the Pledge Allegiance to the Flag.

4.  CEREMONIAL MATTERS

  The Commission proceeded with the annual reorganization of the Commission in
  appointing the Chairperson and Vice-Chairperson for a one-year term.

  Secretary Monroy opened nominations for election of Chairperson.
  Commissioner Nimri nominated Commissioner Stoll for Chairperson, seconded
  by Commissioner Xu.

  Commissioner Stoll was appointment Chairperson by acclamation.

  Chairperson Stoll opened nominations for election of Vice-Chairperson.
  Chairperson Stoll nominated Commissioner Catalan for Vice-Chairperson,
  seconded by Commissioner Nimri.

  Commissioner Catalan was appointment as Vice Chairperson by acclamation.

5.  PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA

  Alex Pan, Temple City resident, presented concerns regarding the extension of
  red curb recently added on the south side of Live Oak Avenue, west of Baldwin
  Avenue. Mr. Pan is requesting the city revisit this site for pedestrian traffic
  safety; new concerns since the additional red cub was installed.
 Transportation and Public Safety Commission Minutes
June 24, 2026
Page 2 of 6

  The Commission unanimously agreed to take out of order, item no. 12 of the
  Agenda, Matters from City Officials. City Manager Bryan Cook announced that
  an engineering study is in process by the City’s contract Transtech Engineers,
  regarding the matter of the additional red curb recently added at Live Oak
  Avenue and Baldwin Avenue. The results of that study will be brought back to the
  Transportation and Public Safety Commission for review at a future meeting.

  Chairperson Stoll, closed public comments.

6.  CONSENT CALENDAR

  A.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES – REGULAR MEETING OF APRIL 8, 2026.

  Commissioner Xu made a motion to approve the consent calendar, as
  amended seconded by Commissioner Lo and carried by the following roll
  call vote:

  AYES:  Commissioner – Lo, Xu, Stoll
  NOES:  Commissioner – None
  ABSENT:  Commissioner – Catalan
  ABSTAIN:  Commissioner – Nimri

  The consent calendar was approved.

7.  PARKING CITATION HEARINGS

  A.  HEARINGS IN PERSON - None

  B.  HEARINGS IN WRITTEN FORM - None

8.  UNFINISHED BUSINESS – None

9.  NEW BUSINESS

  A. REVIEW THE ENGINEERING RECOMMENDATIONS FOR THE
  INTERSECTIONS OF SERENO DRIVE AND SULTANA AVENUE,
  (LOCATION 1), AND PENTLAND STREET AND SULTANA AVENUE,
  (LOCATION 2), AND THE NEED FOR ALL WAY STOP CONTROL AT THE
  INTERSECTIONS.

  Commissioner Nimri made a motion to approve item 9A, Resolution No.
  26-0001, seconded by Chairperson Stoll and carried by the following roll call
  vote:

  AYES:  Commissioner – Lo, Nimri, Stoll, Xu
  NOES:  Commissioner – None
  ABSENT:  Commissioner – Catalan
  ABSTAIN:  Commissioner – None

  Item 9A was approved.

  B. REVIEW AND DISCUSS THE FINDINGS AND RECOMMENDATIONS OF
  THE TRAFFIC ENGINEERING REPORT CONCERNING THE PROPOSED
  INSTALLATION OF SPEED HUMPS FOR THE 6100 BLOCK OF CAMELLIA
  AVENUE NORTH OF GARIBALDI AVENUE.

  Chairperson Stoll opened public comments.

  Loi Banh, Temple City resident, commented that he is in favor of speed
  bumps. Mr. Banh also presented concerns of speeding in neighboring
  streets, including McClintock Avenue, where he resides.

  Chairperson Stoll closed public comments.

  Chairperson Stoll made a motion to approve item 9B, Resolution No.
  26-0002, recommendation item 1. of the engineering report, but not to
  approve recommendation item 2., of the engineering report, seconded by
  Commissioner Nimri and carried by the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Commissioner – Lo, Nimri, Stoll
  NOES:  Commissioner – Xu
  ABSENT:  Commissioner – Catalan
  ABSTAIN:  Commissioner – None

  Item 9B was approved as amended.

  C. REVIEW THE RECOMMENDATION OF THE TRAFFIC ENGINEERING
  REPORT TO INSTALL AN ADDITIONAL 13 FEET OF RED CURB ON THE
  NORTHWEST SIDE OF SANTA ANITA AVENUE, RESULTING IN A TOTAL
  OF 31 FEET OF RED CURB NORTH OF THE INTERSECTION OF SANTA
  ANITA AVENUE AND GRAND AVENUE, WHILE RETAINING 20 FEET OF
  AVAILABLE CURB FOR PARKING, AND APPROVE OR DENY THE
  RECOMMENDATION.

  Chairperson Stoll opened public comments

  Loi Banh, Temple City resident, commented that he’s observed a lot of
  speeding in the area of the report.

  Chairperson Stoll closed public comments.

  Commissioner Xu made a motion to approve Resolution no. 26-0003,
  seconded by Chairperson Stoll, and carried by the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Commissioner – Lo, Nimri, Xu, Stoll

  Item 9C was approved.

  D. REVIEW THE RECOMMENDATION OF THE TRAFFIC ENGINEERING

  APPROVE OR DENY THE RECOMMENDATION TO ADD 20 FEET OF RED
  CURB ON THE SOUTH SIDE OF BROADWAY WEST OF THE SHOPPING

  Chairperson Stoll opened public comments.

  Chairperson Stoll closed public comments.

  Commissioner Xu made a motion to approve 9D, Resolution No. 26-0004,
  seconded by Commissioner Lo and carried by the following roll call vote:

  AYES:  Commissioner – Lo, Nimri, Xu, Stoll
  NOES:  Commissioner – None
  ABSENT:  Commissioner – Catalan
  ABSTAIN:  Commissioner – None

  Item 9D was approved.

10.  COMMUNICATIONS – None

11.  ADDITIONAL PUBLIC COMMENTS ON ITEMS NOT LISTED ON THE AGENDA -

  None

12.  MATTERS FROM CITY OFFICIALS – City Manager Cook provided Public
  Safety Department updates to the Transportation and Public Safety Commission.

June 24, 2026

13.  COMMISSION ITEMS SEPARATE FROM THE REGULAR AGENDA

  A.  COMMISSIONER LO

  Commissioner Lo thanked staff for the preparation of the meeting
  and is happy with the recent park attendance by the public.
  Commissioner Lo would like more public announcements on E-bike
  safety and rules of the road.

  B.  COMMISSIONER NIMRI

  Commissioner Nimri thanked fellow commissioners for their
  assistance while he served as Chairman, and city staff.
  Commissioner NImri commented on safety concerns with E-bike
  drivers and requested that Sheriff patrol equipment be moved
  around to various locations and not just stay at one location. City
  Manager Cook provided an update regarding E-Bike enforcement.

  C.  COMMSSIONER XU

  Commissioner Xu commented that he is happy to be back to
  peaceful Temple City and requested an update from staff regarding
  the Longden Elementary traffic circulation.

  D.  VICE CHAIRPERSON CATALAN

  None

  E.  CHAIRPERSON STOLL

  Chairperson Stoll thanked former Chairperson Nimri for his service
  and requested that the City evaluate the intersection of Broadway
  and Temple City Boulevard to determine whether additional traffic
  safety measures are warranted due to traffic accidents.
